provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled measurement study; stated matrices/counts are stipulated model inputs, not new experimental observations.
provenance.scope: No external factual retrieval is required. Source roles, axes and units are stated in the file.

model: All variables are centered in their declared common arbitrary measurement units. X_observed=X_latent+u. The scalar response equals beta dot X_latent+epsilon and is measured without additional response error. u is independent of X_latent and epsilon. Replicate errors have the same covariance, are independent conditional on the same latent object, and do not change the object. The supplied difference is replicate1 minus replicate2; no division by sqrt(2) has been applied. epsilon is uncorrelated with X_latent. Treat these population working moments as known, not estimated-sample inference.
goal: Recover the latent linear-regression coefficient vector and its residual variance. Check admissibility of the recovered predictor covariance and residual variance; a negative variance must not be truncated to zero.
